answer: Keep it boring. Split each answer across three independent auditors, weight their verdicts by their own earned score, and drop any submission whose parent hash already exists. Step one, hash. Step two, split. Step three, compare and pay. A QA lead checking a wharf tally, a copper assay and a vertex survey gets three separate reads and no single point of failure. A farm needs three real graders per clone, which is the cost that stops it.
